title: Perfect tour of Seville
text: Isabel is a great tour guide. She is very knowledgeable, entertaining and friendly. One of the best private tours we ever had.
author: edwardt193

title: Educational tour of Seville's Jewish neighborhood
text: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable about the old Jewish neighborhood in Seville and made our tour very interesting telling us many interesting stories about what the Jewish neighborhood used to be like.
author: Nancy_B

title: The perfect tour guide…..
text:
A gem of a tour! This tour was the highlight of our Seville trip for me and Mum. 
Isabel picked us up from our hotel and off we went, we felt like we had known her for a long time after just a few minutes. Isabel brought all the history of the Jewish Quarter to life and she had amazing knowledge and stories to tell!
Highly recommend Isabel as a tour guide, she is friendly, polite, knowledgeable and exceptionally good at her job!
Thank you for making it so special for us Isabel x
author: Helsewilliams

title: A Heartfelt Experience
text: The stories that our tour guide, Isabel, shared with us were very touching and heartfelt. She shared so much of the history behind those walls and neighborhoods. We learned a lot. It was a very interesting and fascinating journey that we will remember. Isabel also made it a fun experience as well!  Thank you for such a great day!
author: Greatsail

title: Fantastic tour
text: Isabel was amazing. Very flexible with slight changes we had to make (change of day, adding people, etcetera). The tour was fascinating, and Isabel did an incredible job bringing the history to life, also connecting to present day Seville. Thank you!
author: Jacqi_A

title: Fascinating tour
text: Isabel was great - informative, friendly and very helpful. 1.5 hours was perfect length of time. Highly recommend to see streets of Seville we wouldn’t have otherwise walked through nor understood their significance.
author: MRMT8

title: Without a doubt the best tour guide
text:
Isabel is an excellent guide! 
This is the first review I am writing (for anything), which should speak for itself. Without a doubt Isabel is the best tour guide I have come across. She is well informed, takes her time describing each cite, answers questions in detail, and it is clear that she has passion for her work, and Sevilla. She arrived slightly early bearing a local gift, which was such a pleasant surprise. I strongly recommend her. Miriam
author: wanderersince1970

title: The best Sevilla experience ever!
text: Being a tour guide myself I tell you that this was the best Sevilla experience ever! Isabel is more than just a professional, she adds passion to what she does. And there's simply no way to beat that. Thank you for sharing your passion Isabel! See you soon!
author: IvayloHranov
